title: Book Three · Chapter 6: The Extra Square
story:
On Thursday morning, Anna draws a square in her notebook.

She draws two lines inside it. Now there are four small squares.

“Five,” she says quietly.

Ronan looks over. “Five what?”

“Squares. Four small ones and one big one.”

He counts them. “Yes.”

Anna draws another square. This time she puts more lines inside it.

“I like these questions,” she says.

“Is it homework?”

“No. I found one in a book. I am making another.”

The teacher comes in. Anna leaves the drawing and turns to a clean page.

During the lesson, Ronan works through the questions on the board. He knows the first two. The third needs more space. He starts it again on the next line.

At the end, the teacher asks everyone to check a partner's answers.

Anna gives Ronan her book. He gives her his.

Their first two answers are the same. For the third, Anna has eighteen. Ronan has sixteen.

They look at the question again.

“I think I lost a two,” Ronan says.

“Where?”

He follows his own numbers with his pencil. Halfway down, he stops.

“Here. I wrote six. It says eight.”

He changes the number and finishes the question again.

Anna waits. She does not write in his book.

“Eighteen,” he says.

“Now check mine.”

He follows her lines. Her numbers are clear. At the bottom, she has written the answer twice.

“Do you want thirty-six?” he asks.

“No. I only want eighteen once.”

She crosses out the second answer.

After the lesson, Anna returns to her drawing. Ronan takes out his lunch, then stops.

“Can I try?”

She moves the notebook between them.

“Count all the squares.”

He counts the smallest ones first. There are nine. Then he sees the large square around them.

“Ten.”

Anna shakes her head. “There are some in the middle too.”

He looks again. She puts one finger near a corner, but she does not trace a shape.

Ronan finds a square with four small squares inside it.

“This one?”

“Yes.”

He finds three more. “Fourteen.”

Anna smiles. “That is my answer too.”

“Do you make these for fun?”

“Yes. You throw a ball at a wall.”

“The wall started it.”

She laughs and takes the notebook back. She wants to try a larger drawing. Ronan opens his lunch box.

He eats while she works. Once, she rubs out a line. Then she puts it back.

Outside, someone calls her name. Anna closes the notebook, marks the page with a ruler, and goes to the door.

Ronan looks at the empty space beside his lunch. He takes his own pencil and draws nine small squares.

This time, he can find all fourteen.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

square＝正方形；partner＝搭档；cross out＝划掉；rub out＝擦掉。

## 理解问题

1. Ronan第三道题为什么算出不同的答案？
2. Anna自己为什么画这些方格？Ronan最初漏掉了哪一类正方形？

## 读句子

**She moves the notebook between them.**

拆开看：She / moves the notebook / between them.

她／把笔记本移过去／移到两人之间。
